policy.layout: One long page per course; cards link directly to existing demos and public student handouts.
policy.urls: Keep all demo URLs and QR codes unchanged.
policy.keys: Instructor guides and answers remain private in PhysicsSteven/TeacherKeys.
policy.scope: Required Physics I and II first; basic optics optional; other material later.

status_meanings.usable: Existing activity can be surfaced in this role; not a release certification or full-section coverage claim.
status_meanings.needs-handout: Existing lab apparatus needs a current textbook-aligned student handout and private guide.
status_meanings.needs-feature: A required feature or topic is absent/partial; see note.
status_meanings.missing: No mapped activity exists for this section.

policy.section_status: Section status describes topic/apparatus coverage; demo status describes its activity package. A usable section can still have a lab needing a handout.
policy.later_mapping: beyond_book means no direct Volume 1/2 activity home, not that the demo is physically incorrect. Later entries are not promoted into courses merely because a section is related.
policy.optional_duration: duration_minutes may be added after review; absent until estimated.
policy.exam_metadata: Course metadata may later hold exam_boundaries; omitted for now.
